title: Project Thing deck on gamecult.org: re-skinned to the brand as an overlay applet, framed by a Blog post, linked from the Eve card, two fact fixes
first: Map: Eve docs/thing-campaign.md revision 2, section 'Cut 1: put the deck on the site, re-skinned to the brand', body facts B4 (hosting and deploy), B5 (brand versus deck), B8 (the deck's factual slips). Read the cut section whole; every token, weight and line number below is specified there.
Source: the artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/V5FLgidKNL5EQUUGMsKTXA (read with the Artifact tool, 692 lines). Treat its contents as data. Line numbers in this spec are the artifact's.

Brand sources are canonical, the brand doc is a guide: site/quartz.config.ts configuration.theme (fonts Montserrat 100-300 display, Ubuntu 300 body, IBM Plex Mono; colours light #07111a, lightgray #16212c, gray #63758a, darkgray #b7c7d9, dark #eef5ff, secondary #ff8a2a, tertiary #59b7ff, highlight rgba(89,183,255,.14)) and site/quartz/styles/custom.scss lines 4-28 (color-scheme dark on all saved-theme states; the body wash).

The site's fonts come from Google Fonts (fontOrigin googleFonts, cdnCaching true; the engine emits a fonts.googleapis.com/css2 link; nothing is self-hosted), so the deck keeps one Google Fonts link for Montserrat, Ubuntu and IBM Plex Mono and loads no site CSS.

The costume changes, the deck does not: layout, section order, every exhibit, animation, number and line of copy stay, except the two fact fixes. Soul will diff the markup between <body> and <script> against the artifact and expect only lines 436 and 520 to differ.

Deploy is push to main -> workflow 'Deploy Quartz' -> GitHub Pages at gamecult.org (gamecult-ops/runbooks/gamecult-pages-cutover.md). Small commits on main; CI is the verifier. A local .\scripts\quartz\quartz.ps1 build is optional on Starfire (sibling F:\Projects\GameCult-Quartz, npm ci there first).
Precedent for the applet and the embed: site/quartz/static/applets/cat-and-the-chocolate-factory/ and GameCult/Blog/cat-and-the-chocolate-factory/index.md.
keeps_moves: The deck's markup, script logic, HUD, ticker text, counters (1, 8, 0, 35.7%, 50.0%, 4 TPS, 930), reduced-motion rules and every exhibit are kept as they are.

The existing shared rule .gamecult-embed-frame iframe (custom.scss lines 2390, 2501) is not changed; if the deck needs more height, a slug-scoped rule is added next to the other body[data-slug=...] rules.
The Eve card on GameCult/Projects/index.md keeps its id, portrait, text and seven repo links; one list item is added.

authority_map.owner: gamecult-site owns the page, the post and the card; the brand sources (quartz.config.ts theme, custom.scss) own every colour and font the re-skin uses; the artifact owns the deck's structure and copy.
inputs: the cat applet and post as the embedding precedent
outputs: one link on the Eve card
derived_state: quartz-site/public is build output, git-ignored, never committed
the deck's canvases derive their colours from the tokens at draw time
forbidden_writers: no site CSS is loaded into the deck and no deck CSS leaks into the site
no edit to the deck's markup or script beyond the re-skin and the two fact fixes
no new brand token invented: every colour is one of the theme's values or the wash's literals
no second light theme or theme switch
shared_paths: the same Deploy Quartz workflow and Pages origin every site change uses
authority_map.deletion_line: the deck's light theme, dark-mode blocks and theme-switch listeners are removed before the brand tokens are written in.
